description: Permanently terminate an instance and release its host allocation. Use only when the user explicitly wants the instance destroyed rather than stopped — prefer cancel_instance for ordinary shutdown. Call it with confirm:false first: that returns a preview of exactly what will be destroyed and changes nothing, so you do not need get_instance beforehand — the preview comes from the tool that will do the work, which a status read does not. Then call again with confirm:true. Stops hourly billing immediately, and is irreversible: instance-local state is destroyed and cannot be recovered.
name: terminate_instance
